arguments.sql:
WITH batting_values AS (
    SELECT player_id, year, g,
           CASE WHEN typeof(r) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN r END AS r,
           CASE WHEN typeof(h) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN h END AS h,
           CASE WHEN typeof(hr) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN hr END AS hr
    FROM main.batting
),
seasons AS (
    SELECT player_id, year, SUM(g) AS g, SUM(r) AS r, SUM(h) AS h, SUM(hr) AS hr
    FROM batting_values
    GROUP BY player_id, year
),
careers AS (
    SELECT player_id, SUM(g) AS g, SUM(r) AS r, SUM(h) AS h, SUM(hr) AS hr
    FROM seasons
    GROUP BY player_id
),
appearance_careers AS (
    SELECT player_id, SUM(g_all) AS g
    FROM main.appearances
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT 'Batting rows' AS source_grain, COUNT(*) AS observations,
       MAX(g) AS max_g, MAX(r) AS max_r, MAX(h) AS max_h, MAX(hr) AS max_hr
FROM batting_values
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Batting player-years', COUNT(*), MAX(g), MAX(r), MAX(h), MAX(hr)
FROM seasons
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Batting players', COUNT(*), MAX(g), MAX(r), MAX(h), MAX(hr)
FROM careers
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Appearance rows', COUNT(*),
       MAX(CASE WHEN typeof(g_all) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN g_all END), NULL, NULL, NULL
FROM main.appearances
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Appearance players', COUNT(*), MAX(g), NULL, NULL, NULL
FROM appearance_careers
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Postseason batting rows', COUNT(*), MAX(g), MAX(r), MAX(h), MAX(hr)
FROM main.batting_postseason
